Others resist the change (“I actually don't love that the common response is ‘have you asked Claude?’ I really enjoy working with people in person and highly value that”) or miss the older way of working: “I like working with people and it is sad that I ‘need’ them less now.” Several pointed out the impact on traditional mentorship dynamics, because “Claude can provide a lot of coaching to junior staff” instead of senior engineers. One senior engineer said:

blocks.text: It's been sad that more junior people don't come to me with questions as often, though they definitely get their questions answered more effectively and learn faster.
blocks.zh: 令人伤心的是, 更多的年轻人 不来问我 经常,虽然他们肯定得到 他们的问题得到更有效的回答 并学习更快。
blocks.en: It's been sad that more junior people don't come to me with questions as often, though they definitely get their questions answered more effectively and learn faster.

blocks.text: Career uncertainty and adaptation
blocks.zh: 职业不确定性和适应性
blocks.en: Career uncertainty and adaptation

blocks.text: Many engineers describe their role shifting from writing code to managing AIs. Engineers increasingly see themselves as “manager[s] of AI agents”—some already “constantly have at least a few [Claude] instances running.” One person estimated their work has shifted “70%+ to being a code reviewer/reviser rather than a net-new code writer” and another saw “taking accountability for the work of 1, 5, or 100 Claudes” as part of their future role.
blocks.zh: 许多工程师表示，他们的职责正从编写代码转向管理 AI。工程师越来越将自己视为“AI 智能体的管理者”，有些人已经“始终让至少几个 Claude 实例同时运行”。一位受访者估计，自己“70% 以上的工作已转为代码审查和修改，而非从零编写新代码”；另一位则认为，“为 1 个、5 个或 100 个 Claude 的工作承担责任”将成为自己未来职责的一部分。
blocks.en: Many engineers describe their role shifting from writing code to managing AIs. Engineers increasingly see themselves as “manager[s] of AI agents”—some already “constantly have at least a few [Claude] instances running.” One person estimated their work has shifted “70%+ to being a code reviewer/reviser rather than a net-new code writer” and another saw “taking accountability for the work of 1, 5, or 100 Claudes” as part of their future role.

blocks.text: In the longer term, career uncertainty is widespread. Engineers saw these changes as harbingers of broader industry transformation, and many said that it was “hard to say” what their careers might look like a few years down the line. Some expressed a conflict between short-term optimism and long-term uncertainty. “I feel optimistic in the short term but in the long term I think AI will end up doing everything and make me and many others irrelevant,” one stated. Others put a finer point on it: “It kind of feels like I'm coming to work every day to put myself out of a job.”
blocks.zh: 从长远来看,职业上的不确定性是普遍的。工程师认为这些变化是更广泛的产业转型的热点因素,许多人说,“很难说”他们的职业生涯在几年后可能是什么样子。一些人表示,短期乐观与长期不确定性之间存在冲突。“我觉得短期而言是乐观的,但从长远来看,我认为大赦国际最终会做一切事情,使我和许多其他人变得无关紧要。”其他人对此作了更细微的阐述:“感觉我每天都来工作,
blocks.en: In the longer term, career uncertainty is widespread. Engineers saw these changes as harbingers of broader industry transformation, and many said that it was “hard to say” what their careers might look like a few years down the line. Some expressed a conflict between short-term optimism and long-term uncertainty. “I feel optimistic in the short term but in the long term I think AI will end up doing everything and make me and many others irrelevant,” one stated. Others put a finer point on it: “It kind of feels like I'm coming to work every day to put myself out of a job.”

blocks.text: Some engineers were more optimistic. One said, “I fear for the junior devs, but I also appreciate that junior devs are maybe the thirstiest for new technology. I feel generally very optimistic about the trajectory of the profession.” They argued that, while there’s a potential risk of inexperienced engineers shipping problematic code, the combination of better AI guardrails, more built-in educational resources, and natural learning from mistakes will help the field adapt over time.
blocks.zh: 一些工程师比较乐观.一个人说,我的确畏惧先民,但我也很感激 年轻的德夫夫妇 也许是对新技术最渴慕的我对这个职业的轨迹普遍感到非常乐观。”虽然有潜在的风险 缺乏经验的工程师 运输问题代码,结合更好的AI护栏,更多的内在教育资源,自然从错误中吸取教训将有助于实地随时间而适应。
blocks.en: Some engineers were more optimistic. One said, “I fear for the junior devs, but I also appreciate that junior devs are maybe the thirstiest for new technology. I feel generally very optimistic about the trajectory of the profession.” They argued that, while there’s a potential risk of inexperienced engineers shipping problematic code, the combination of better AI guardrails, more built-in educational resources, and natural learning from mistakes will help the field adapt over time.

blocks.text: We asked how people envision their future roles and whether they have any adaptation strategies. Some mentioned plans to specialize further (“developing the skill to meaningfully review AI’s work will take longer and require more specialization”), some anticipated focusing on more interpersonal and strategic work in the future (“we will spend more time finding consensus and let the AIs spend more time on the implementation”). One said they use Claude specifically for career development, getting feedback from it on work and leadership skills (“The rate at which I can learn things or even just be effective without fully learning things just completely changed. I almost feel like the ceiling just shattered for me”).
blocks.zh: 我们询问人们如何设想他们未来的作用,他们是否有适应战略。一些人提到计划进一步专门化( " 开发对大赦国际的工作进行有意义的审查的技能需要更长的时间,需要更多的专门化 " ),有些人预期今后将把重点放在更多的人际工作和战略性工作上(“我们将花更多的时间寻求共识,让大赦国际花更多的时间来讨论”。执行)一个说他们利用Claude 专门促进事业发展从它那里得到关于工作和领导技能的反馈(“我学习事物的速度,甚至有效而不完全学习事物的速度,只是彻底改变而已。我几乎觉得天花板 刚刚破碎我。”
blocks.en: We asked how people envision their future roles and whether they have any adaptation strategies. Some mentioned plans to specialize further (“developing the skill to meaningfully review AI’s work will take longer and require more specialization”), some anticipated focusing on more interpersonal and strategic work in the future (“we will spend more time finding consensus and let the AIs spend more time on the implementation”). One said they use Claude specifically for career development, getting feedback from it on work and leadership skills (“The rate at which I can learn things or even just be effective without fully learning things just completely changed. I almost feel like the ceiling just shattered for me”).

blocks.text: Overall, many acknowledge deep uncertainty: “I have very low confidence in what specific skills I think will be useful in the future.” A team lead said: “Nobody knows what's going to happen… the important thing is to just be really adaptable.”
blocks.zh: 总体而言,许多人承认存在深刻的不确定性:“我不太相信我认为今后哪些具体技能是有用的。”“没有人知道会发生什么... 重要的是要真正适应性。”
blocks.en: Overall, many acknowledge deep uncertainty: “I have very low confidence in what specific skills I think will be useful in the future.” A team lead said: “Nobody knows what's going to happen… the important thing is to just be really adaptable.”

blocks.text: Claude Code usage trends
blocks.zh: Claude 代码使用趋势
blocks.en: Claude Code usage trends

blocks.text: The survey and interview data show that increased Claude usage is helping people work faster and take on new types of work, though this comes with tensions around AI delegation and skill development. Still, self-reported data only tells part of the story. To complement this, we also analyzed actual Claude usage data across Anthropic teams. Because survey respondents reported Claude Code as the majority of their usage, we used our privacy-preserving analysis tool to analyze 200,000 internal transcripts from Claude Code from February and August 2025.
blocks.zh: 调查和访谈数据显示,Claude使用率的提高正在帮助人们加快工作速度,从事新型工作,然而,这与大赦国际代表团和技能发展之间的紧张关系有关。不过,自报数据只讲述部分故事.为了补充这一点,我们还分析了整个Anthropic团队中 Claude的实际使用数据因为调查答卷人称Claude代码是他们的大部分使用方式,我们用我们的隐私保护分析工具 分析了2025年2月和8月 Claude代码的20万份内部记录
blocks.en: The survey and interview data show that increased Claude usage is helping people work faster and take on new types of work, though this comes with tensions around AI delegation and skill development. Still, self-reported data only tells part of the story. To complement this, we also analyzed actual Claude usage data across Anthropic teams. Because survey respondents reported Claude Code as the majority of their usage, we used our privacy-preserving analysis tool to analyze 200,000 internal transcripts from Claude Code from February and August 2025.

blocks.text: Tackling harder problems with less oversight
blocks.zh: 减少监督,解决更困难的问题
blocks.en: Tackling harder problems with less oversight

blocks.text: Claude Code usage has shifted toward more difficult and autonomous coding tasks over the last six months: (Figure 3):
blocks.zh: 过去6个月,Claude代码的使用转向了更困难和自主的编码工作:(图3):

Task complexity increased from 3.2 to 3.8 on average.To illustrate the difference between the scores: tasks averaging 3.2 included “Troubleshoot Python module import errors” while tasks averaging 3.8 included “Implement and optimize caching systems.”
blocks.zh: 雇员正在用Claude Code处理日益复杂的任务。我们按1至5级对每份记录稿的任务复杂性作了估计,其中1份与“基本编辑”相对应,5份与“需要数周/月人力专家工作的专家级任务”相对应。任务复杂程度平均从3.2提高到3.8。平均任务3.2包括“Troubleshot Python模块导入错误”,平均任务3.8包括“安装和优化缓存系统”。

We estimated task complexity of each transcript on a 1-5 scale where 1 corresponds to “basic edits” and 5 is “expert-level tasks requiring weeks/months of human expert work”. Task complexity increased from 3.2 to 3.8 on average.To illustrate the difference between the scores: tasks averaging 3.2 included “Troubleshoot Python module import errors” while tasks averaging 3.8 included “Implement and optimize caching systems.”

blocks.text: The maximum number of consecutive tool calls Claude Code makes per transcript increased by 116%. Tool calls correspond to actions Claude takes using external tools like making edits to files or running commands. Claude now chains together 21.2 independent tool calls without need for human intervention versus 9.8 tool calls from six months ago.
blocks.zh: Claude Code每笔录的连续工具数最多增加了116%。工具调用对应克洛德使用外部工具采取的行动,如将编辑制作成文件或运行命令.Claude现在把21.2个独立工具的电话连在一起,不需要人干预,而六个月前的9.8个工具的电话。
blocks.en: The maximum number of consecutive tool calls Claude Code makes per transcript increased by 116%. Tool calls correspond to actions Claude takes using external tools like making edits to files or running commands. Claude now chains together 21.2 independent tool calls without need for human intervention versus 9.8 tool calls from six months ago.

blocks.text: The number of human turns decreased by 33%. The average number of human turns decreased from 6.2 to 4.1 per transcript, suggesting that less human input is necessary to accomplish a given task now compared to six months ago.
blocks.zh: 人转弯的次数减少了33%.人类转弯的平均次数从每张记录片的6.2次下降到4.1次,说明与六个月前相比,现在完成某项任务所需的人力投入较少。
blocks.en: The number of human turns decreased by 33%. The average number of human turns decreased from 6.2 to 4.1 per transcript, suggesting that less human input is necessary to accomplish a given task now compared to six months ago.

blocks.en: Changes in Claude Code usage between August 2025 and February 2025 (x-axes). Average task complexity increased over time (left panel), average maximum consecutive tool calls per transcript increased over time (middle panel), and number of human turns decreased over time (right panel). Error bars show 95% confidence intervals. The data suggest people are increasingly delegating more autonomy to Claude over time.

blocks.text: These usage data corroborate the survey data: engineers delegate increasingly complex work to Claude and Claude requires less oversight. It seems plausible that this is driving the observed productivity gains.
blocks.zh: 这些使用数据证实了调查数据:工程师将越来越复杂的工作交给Claude和Claude,需要较少的监督。这似乎正在推动所观察到的生产率的提高。
blocks.en: These usage data corroborate the survey data: engineers delegate increasingly complex work to Claude and Claude requires less oversight. It seems plausible that this is driving the observed productivity gains.

blocks.text: Distribution of tasks
blocks.zh: 任务分配
blocks.en: Distribution of tasks

blocks.text: We classified Claude Code transcripts into one or more types of coding tasks, studying how the uses for different tasks have evolved over the last six months:
blocks.zh: 我们把Claude代码记录稿 归类为一种或多种编码任务研究过去六个月不同任务的用途是如何演变的:
blocks.en: We classified Claude Code transcripts into one or more types of coding tasks, studying how the uses for different tasks have evolved over the last six months:

blocks.text: Distribution of various coding tasks (y-axis) as a percentage of the overall number of records (x-axis). We compare the distribution 6 months ago (pink) to present day (purple). The y-axis is ordered by frequency in Feb 2025.
blocks.zh: 各种编码任务的分布(y轴)占记录总数的百分比(x轴).我们比较6个月前的分布(平克)到现在(普尔普尔).y轴于2025年2月按频率订购.
blocks.en: Distribution of various coding tasks (y-axis) as a percentage of the overall number of records (x-axis). We compare the distribution 6 months ago (pink) to present day (purple). The y-axis is ordered by frequency in Feb 2025.

blocks.text: The overall task frequency distribution estimated from usage data roughly aligns with the self-reported task frequency distribution. The most striking change between February and August 2025 is that there now are proportionately many more transcripts using Claude to implement new features (14.3% → 36.9%) and do code design or planning (1.0% → 9.9%). This shift in the relative distribution of Claude Code tasks may suggest that Claude has become better at these more complex tasks, though it could also reflect changes in how teams adopt Claude Code for different workflows rather than increases in absolute work volume (see Appendix for more limitations).
blocks.zh: 根据使用数据估计的总体任务频率分布大致与自报的任务频率分布一致。2025年2月至8月期间最引人注目的变化是,现在有比例上更多的记录誊本使用Claude来实施新的功能(14.3%)——36.9%),并且做了代码设计或规划(1.0%~9.9%).Claude Code任务相对分布的这种转变可能表明Claude在这些更为复杂的任务上表现得更好,虽然它也可以反映团队在不同的工作流程中采用Claude码的方式的变化,而不是绝对工作量的增加(更多限制,见附录).
blocks.en: The overall task frequency distribution estimated from usage data roughly aligns with the self-reported task frequency distribution. The most striking change between February and August 2025 is that there now are proportionately many more transcripts using Claude to implement new features (14.3% → 36.9%) and do code design or planning (1.0% → 9.9%). This shift in the relative distribution of Claude Code tasks may suggest that Claude has become better at these more complex tasks, though it could also reflect changes in how teams adopt Claude Code for different workflows rather than increases in absolute work volume (see Appendix for more limitations).

blocks.text: Fixing papercuts
blocks.zh: 修复剪纸机
blocks.en: Fixing papercuts

blocks.text: We found from the survey that engineers now spend more time making small quality-of-life improvements; in line with this, 8.6% of current Claude Code tasks are classified as “papercut fixes”. These include larger tasks such as creating performance visualization tools and refactoring code for maintainability, as well as smaller tasks like creating terminal shortcuts. This may contribute to engineers’ reported productivity gains (addressing previously neglected quality-of-life improvements may lead to more efficiency over time) and potentially reducing friction and frustration in daily work.
blocks.zh: 我们从调查中发现,工程师们现在花更多的时间来进行小的生活质量改进;根据这一点,目前Claude Code的任务有8.6%被归类为“纸张修正”。其中包括更大的任务,如创建性能可视化工具和为可维护性重构代码,以及创建终端快捷键等较小的任务.这可能有利于工程师报告生产率的提高(处理以前被忽视的生活质量的提高可能会随着时间推移而提高效率),并有可能提高生产率。减少日常工作中的摩擦和挫折感。
blocks.en: We found from the survey that engineers now spend more time making small quality-of-life improvements; in line with this, 8.6% of current Claude Code tasks are classified as “papercut fixes”. These include larger tasks such as creating performance visualization tools and refactoring code for maintainability, as well as smaller tasks like creating terminal shortcuts. This may contribute to engineers’ reported productivity gains (addressing previously neglected quality-of-life improvements may lead to more efficiency over time) and potentially reducing friction and frustration in daily work.

blocks.en: The Pre-training team (who help to train Claude) often uses Claude Code for building new features (54.6%), much of which is running extra experiments.

blocks.en: The Security team often uses Claude Code for code understanding (48.9%), specifically analyzing and understanding the security implications of different parts of the codebase.

blocks.text: Non-technical employees often use Claude Code for debugging (51.5%), such as troubleshooting network issues or Git operations, as well as for data science (12.7%); Claude appears to be valuable for bridging gaps in technical knowledge.
blocks.zh: 非技术雇员经常使用Claude代码进行调试(51.5%),例如排除网络问题或Git操作,以及数据科学(12.7%);Claude似乎对弥合技术知识差距很有价值。
blocks.en: Non-technical employees often use Claude Code for debugging (51.5%), such as troubleshooting network issues or Git operations, as well as for data science (12.7%); Claude appears to be valuable for bridging gaps in technical knowledge.

blocks.text: Many of these team-specific patterns demonstrate the same capability expansion we observed in our survey and interviews: enabling new kinds of work that those on the team either wouldn't have the time or the skillset to do otherwise. For example, the pretraining team ran lots of additional experiments and non-technical employees were able to fix errors in code. And whereas the data suggests that teams do use Claude for their core tasks (for instance, the Infrastructure team most commonly uses Claude Code for infrastructure and DevOps work), Claude often also augments their core tasks (for instance, researchers use Claude for front-end development to better visualize their data). This suggests that Claude is enabling everyone to become more full-stack in their work.

blocks.en: Many of these team-specific patterns demonstrate the same capability expansion we observed in our survey and interviews: enabling new kinds of work that those on the team either wouldn't have the time or the skillset to do otherwise. For example, the pretraining team ran lots of additional experiments and non-technical employees were able to fix errors in code. And whereas the data suggests that teams do use Claude for their core tasks (for instance, the Infrastructure team most commonly uses Claude Code for infrastructure and DevOps work), Claude often also augments their core tasks (for instance, researchers use Claude for front-end development to better visualize their data). This suggests that Claude is enabling everyone to become more full-stack in their work.

blocks.text: Looking forward
blocks.zh: 展望未来
blocks.en: Looking forward

blocks.text: Anthropic employees have greatly increased their use of Claude over the past year, using it to not only accelerate existing work but to learn new codebases, reduce toil, expand into new domains, and tackle previously neglected improvements. As Claude becomes more autonomous and capable, engineers are discovering new ways to use AI delegation while also figuring out what skills they’ll need in the future. These shifts bring clear productivity and learning benefits alongside genuine uncertainty about the longer-term trajectory of software engineering work. Will AI resemble past software engineering transitions—from lower- to higher-level programming languages, or from individual contributor to manager, as several engineers suggested? Or will it go further?
blocks.zh: 过去一年，Anthropic 员工大幅增加了对 Claude 的使用。他们不仅用它加快现有工作，还用它学习新的代码库、减少重复劳动、拓展到新领域，并处理此前被忽视的改进事项。随着 Claude 的自主性和能力提升，工程师一边探索将任务交给 AI 的新方式，一边思考未来需要哪些技能。这些变化带来了明确的生产力和学习收益，但软件工程工作的长期走向仍存在切实的不确定性。AI 会像过去软件工程领域的转型一样——从低级编程语言转向高级编程语言，或像几位工程师所说，从个人贡献者转向管理者？还是会走得更远？
blocks.en: Anthropic employees have greatly increased their use of Claude over the past year, using it to not only accelerate existing work but to learn new codebases, reduce toil, expand into new domains, and tackle previously neglected improvements. As Claude becomes more autonomous and capable, engineers are discovering new ways to use AI delegation while also figuring out what skills they’ll need in the future. These shifts bring clear productivity and learning benefits alongside genuine uncertainty about the longer-term trajectory of software engineering work. Will AI resemble past software engineering transitions—from lower- to higher-level programming languages, or from individual contributor to manager, as several engineers suggested? Or will it go further?

blocks.text: It’s still early days—Anthropic has many early adopters internally, the landscape is rapidly changing, and our findings likely don’t generalize to other organizations or contexts right now (see Appendix for more limitations). This research reflects that uncertainty: the findings are nuanced, with no single consensus or clear directives emerging. But it does raise questions about how we can thoughtfully and effectively navigate these changes.
blocks.zh: 国内有许多早期领养者,地貌正在迅速变化,而我们的调查结果可能不会概括到其他组织或背景(更多限制见附录)。这项研究反映了这种不确定性:调查结果是细微的,没有形成单一的共识或明确的指示。但是,这确实提出了我们如何能周到和有效地驾驭这些变化的问题。
blocks.en: It’s still early days—Anthropic has many early adopters internally, the landscape is rapidly changing, and our findings likely don’t generalize to other organizations or contexts right now (see Appendix for more limitations). This research reflects that uncertainty: the findings are nuanced, with no single consensus or clear directives emerging. But it does raise questions about how we can thoughtfully and effectively navigate these changes.

blocks.text: To follow up on this initial work, we’re taking several steps. We're talking to Anthropic engineers, researchers, and leadership to address the opportunities and challenges raised. This includes examining how we bring teams together and collaborate with each other, how we support professional development, and/or how we establish best practices for AI-augmented work (e.g. guided by our AI fluency framework). We're also expanding this research beyond engineers to understand how AI transformation affects roles across the organization and supporting external organizations such as CodePath as they adapt computer science curricula for an AI-assisted future. Looking ahead, we're also considering structural approaches that may become increasingly relevant as AI capabilities advance, like new pathways for role evolution or reskilling within the organization.
blocks.zh: 为落实这项初步工作,我们正采取若干步骤。我们正在和Anthropic工程师谈话,研究人员,发挥带头作用,应对提出的机遇和挑战。这包括审查我们如何将各小组聚集在一起并相互合作,我们如何支持专业发展,和/或我们如何为人工智能强化工作确立最佳做法(如:以我们的AI流畅框架为指导).我们还在将这一研究扩大到工程师以外,以了解AI转型如何影响整个组织的作用,并支持外部组织,例如:CodePath),他们将计算机科学课程改编为AI辅助的未来.展望未来,我们还在考虑随着人工智能能力的发展 结构方法可能变得越来越重要像是组织内部角色演化或重新技能的新途径。
blocks.en: To follow up on this initial work, we’re taking several steps. We're talking to Anthropic engineers, researchers, and leadership to address the opportunities and challenges raised. This includes examining how we bring teams together and collaborate with each other, how we support professional development, and/or how we establish best practices for AI-augmented work (e.g. guided by our AI fluency framework). We're also expanding this research beyond engineers to understand how AI transformation affects roles across the organization and supporting external organizations such as CodePath as they adapt computer science curricula for an AI-assisted future. Looking ahead, we're also considering structural approaches that may become increasingly relevant as AI capabilities advance, like new pathways for role evolution or reskilling within the organization.

blocks.text: We expect to share more concrete plans in 2026 as our thinking matures. Anthropic is a laboratory for responsible workplace transition; we want to not just study how AI transforms work, but also experiment with how to navigate that transformation thoughtfully, starting with ourselves first.
blocks.zh: 随着我们思想的成熟,我们期望在2026年分享更多的具体计划.Anthropic是一个负责工作场所过渡的实验室;我们不想仅仅研究AI如何转变工作,也尝试如何周知这种转变,先从我们自己开始
blocks.en: We expect to share more concrete plans in 2026 as our thinking matures. Anthropic is a laboratory for responsible workplace transition; we want to not just study how AI transforms work, but also experiment with how to navigate that transformation thoughtfully, starting with ourselves first.

blocks.text: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制
blocks.en: Limitations

blocks.text: Our survey findings are subject to several methodological limitations. We selected respondents through both convenience sampling and purposive sampling (to ensure broad organizational representation). We posted the survey across multiple internal Slack channels, yielding 68 responses, and we also selected 20 diverse teams across research and product functions from the organizational chart and directly messaged 5-10 individuals per team (n=207 total outreach), getting a 31% response rate for the final 64 responses. We interviewed the first 53 people who responded. There is likely some selection bias here, as people who are particularly engaged with Claude or have strong opinions (positive or negative) may have been more likely to respond, while those with more neutral experiences may have been underrepresented.
blocks.zh: 我们的调查结果在方法上受到若干限制。我们通过方便抽样和有针对性的抽样(以确保广泛的组织代表性)选择了答卷人。我们通过多个Slack内部渠道公布调查结果,共收到68份答复,我们还从组织结构图中挑选了20个不同的研究和产品职能小组,并直接传达每个小组5-10人的信息(总外联人数=207人),最后64份答复的答复率为31%。我们采访了第一批回应的53人。这里可能存在一些选择偏差,由于与Claude特别接触或有强烈观点(正面或负面观点)的人可能更有可能作出反应,具有较中性经验的人可能任职人数不足。
blocks.en: Our survey findings are subject to several methodological limitations. We selected respondents through both convenience sampling and purposive sampling (to ensure broad organizational representation). We posted the survey across multiple internal Slack channels, yielding 68 responses, and we also selected 20 diverse teams across research and product functions from the organizational chart and directly messaged 5-10 individuals per team (n=207 total outreach), getting a 31% response rate for the final 64 responses. We interviewed the first 53 people who responded. There is likely some selection bias here, as people who are particularly engaged with Claude or have strong opinions (positive or negative) may have been more likely to respond, while those with more neutral experiences may have been underrepresented.

blocks.text: Additionally, responses may be affected by social desirability bias (since responses were not anonymous and all participants are Anthropic employees, respondents may have inflated positive assessments of Claude's impact) and recency bias (asking participants to recall their productivity and usage patterns from 12 months ago is subject to memory distortion). Furthermore, as discussed, productivity is in general very difficult to estimate, so these self-reports should be taken with a grain of salt. These self-reported perceptions should be interpreted alongside our more objective Claude Code usage data, and future research would benefit from anonymous data collection and more robustly validated measurement instruments.
blocks.zh: 此外,应对措施可能受到社会可取性偏见的影响(因为应对措施不是匿名的,而且所有参与者都是Anthropic雇员;答复者可能夸大了对Claude影响的积极评价)和复习偏差(要求参与者回顾12个月前的生产力和使用模式是:受内存扭曲影响).还有,经讨论,一般来说,生产力很难估计,所以这些自我报告应该用一粒盐来取.这些自我报告的看法应该与我们更客观的Claude代码使用数据一起解释,匿名数据收集和经更有力验证的计量工具将有益于今后的研究。
blocks.en: Additionally, responses may be affected by social desirability bias (since responses were not anonymous and all participants are Anthropic employees, respondents may have inflated positive assessments of Claude's impact) and recency bias (asking participants to recall their productivity and usage patterns from 12 months ago is subject to memory distortion). Furthermore, as discussed, productivity is in general very difficult to estimate, so these self-reports should be taken with a grain of salt. These self-reported perceptions should be interpreted alongside our more objective Claude Code usage data, and future research would benefit from anonymous data collection and more robustly validated measurement instruments.

blocks.text: Our Claude Code analysis uses proportionate sampling across time periods, which means we can only measure relative changes in task distribution, not absolute changes in work volume. For example, when we report that feature implementation increased from 14% to 37% of Claude Code usage, this does not necessarily indicate that more total feature work is being done.
blocks.zh: 我们的Claude代码分析 使用不同时期的 比例抽样这意味着我们只能衡量任务分配的相对变化,并非工作量的绝对变化。举例来说,当我们报告Claude代码的使用率从14%增加到37%时,这并不一定表明正在做更多的全面工作。
blocks.en: Our Claude Code analysis uses proportionate sampling across time periods, which means we can only measure relative changes in task distribution, not absolute changes in work volume. For example, when we report that feature implementation increased from 14% to 37% of Claude Code usage, this does not necessarily indicate that more total feature work is being done.

blocks.text: Finally, this research was conducted in August 2025 when Claude Sonnet 4 and Claude Opus 4 were our state-of-the-art models. Given the rapid pace of AI development, the patterns we observed may have already shifted as newer models become available.
blocks.zh: 终于这一研究是在2025年8月进行的,当时Claude·索内特4和Claude·奥普斯4是我们最先进的模型.鉴于AI开发的迅猛步伐,我们观察到的模式可能已经随着新的模式的出现而改变。
blocks.en: Finally, this research was conducted in August 2025 when Claude Sonnet 4 and Claude Opus 4 were our state-of-the-art models. Given the rapid pace of AI development, the patterns we observed may have already shifted as newer models become available.

keyPoints.zh: Anthropic工程师和研究人员最常使用Claude来修补代码错误和了解代码库.调试和代码理解是最常用的用途(图1).
keyPoints.en: Anthropic engineers and researchers use Claude most often for fixing code errors and learning about the codebase. Debugging and code understanding are the most common uses (Figure 1).

keyPoints.zh: 人们报告说,Claude的使用率和生产率提高了。员工在60%的工作中使用Claude进行自我报告,实现50%的生产率提升,a 比去年这个时候增加2-3x。
keyPoints.en: People report increasing Claude usage and productivity gains. Employees self-report using Claude in 60% of their work and achieving a 50% productivity boost, a 2-3x increase from this time last year.

keyPoints.zh: 大多数雇员经常使用Claude,同时报告他们可以“完全委托”他们工作的0-20%。Claude是一个经常的合作者 但使用它一般涉及 积极的监督和验证,特别是在高额工作方面,相对于完全不需要核查的移交任务而言。
keyPoints.en: Most employees use Claude frequently while reporting they can “fully delegate” 0-20% of their work to it. Claude is a constant collaborator but using it generally involves active supervision and validation, especially in high-stakes work—versus handing off tasks requiring no verification at all.

keyPoints.zh: 我们调查了全组织的132名人类工程师和研究人员 关于他们使用Claude的情况,来更好地了解他们是如何 准确的日常使用它。我们通过内部沟通渠道和直接接触代表研究和产品职能的不同团队的雇员,散发了我们的调查。
keyPoints.en: We surveyed 132 Anthropic engineers and researchers from across the organization about their Claude use, to better understand how exactly they were using it day-to-day. We distributed our survey through internal communication channels and direct outreach to employees across diverse teams representing both research and product functions.
